- Research how Pencil (.pen), Paper and similar tools do it.
- "remember this needs to work for all our users, across their many languages and frameworks".
- "ask fable for a proper spec for this, i already talked about this in the prd".
- A project may have no Vite: "What if the project is pure design … no vite?", "Isnt it just components and agnostic?... how does figma or pen or paper does it?"

Later answers, probably after that window: "Pin; agent edits the code", "Real code from the first screen", and "Just use ur own canvas…".
